component.name: Janitux
component.summary: Indaga su cosa riempie il disco

description.p: Every full disk has a culprit. Janitux, the disk janitor, scans a folder or a whole disk and names the main suspects right away: huge single files, big folders buried deep, caches and forgotten leftovers. Then walk the tree column by column, always sorted by size, and move what you no longer need to the trash.

ul.li: Main suspects, ranked with a TF-IDF-like score, with the clues against each one
Column browser: each folder opens to the right, always sorted by size
Interactive treemap and sunburst of the selected folder
Breakdown by kind of content: video, images, audio, archives, code…
Moves to the trash by default; permanent deletion asks first
Empties the trash, after you type a confirmation word
Activity log of every scan and deletion, also kept in a file
Fast multi-threaded scan, hard links counted once

screenshot.caption: The main suspects, right after the scan
Columns sorted by size, with the treemap of the selected folder
Start page with every disk and how full it is

ul.li: Empty the trash from the start page or the menu; you confirm by typing a word
Messages appear in the header bar instead of covering the buttons
Activity log in the header bar, and a log file of scans and deletions
The header tells what went to the trash apart from what was really freed
Fixed: copying a path to the clipboard
Main suspects: the items most likely filling the disk, shown right after the scan
The treemap is the default chart; the deepest column fills the free space
No more pause right after scanning big trees
